Fix `plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/conditionalSchema.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. `yarn tsc` fails with 8 errors, all at one spot in this file. The `if (hasIf) {` block accesses `stepSchema.if.properties` and `stepSchema.if.required` without narrowing `stepSchema.if` to an object first, so TypeScript reports it as possibly null/undefined and as having no such property on `string | number | boolean | JsonObject | JsonArray`:

  299:18 error TS18049: 'stepSchema.if' is possibly 'null' or 'undefined'.
  299:32 error TS2339: Property 'properties' does not exist on type 'string | number | boolean | JsonObject | JsonArray'.
  300:37 error TS18049: 'stepSchema.if' is possibly 'null' or 'undefined'.
  300:51 error TS2339: Property 'properties' does not exist on type 'string | number | boolean | JsonObject | JsonArray'.
  304:23 error TS18049: 'stepSchema.if' is possibly 'null' or 'undefined'.
  304:37 error TS2339: Property 'required' does not exist on type 'string | number | boolean | JsonObject | JsonArray'.
  305:25 error TS18049: 'stepSchema.if' is possibly 'null' or 'undefined'.
  305:39 error TS2339: Property 'required' does not exist on type 'string | number | boolean | JsonObject | JsonArray'.

Fix it with the narrowing pattern this same file already uses successfully at line 42 (`if (isObject(node.if)) { if (isObject(node.if.properties)) { ... } }`): bind the narrowed value to a local once, e.g. `const ifSchema = isObject(stepSchema.if) ? stepSchema.if : undefined;` and read `ifSchema.properties` / `ifSchema.required` under that guard, or wrap the block in `isObject(stepSchema.if)`.

Constraints: do not change any behaviour, do not use `any`, do not add a `@ts-ignore`/`@ts-expect-error`, and do not weaken the `isObject` type guard. This is a type-narrowing fix only. Every existing test in conditionalSchema.test.ts must keep passing, and `yarn eslint --max-warnings 0` on this file must stay clean.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.
